newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK MOTOR ACCIDENTS UP 9.8PCT Y/Y IN JAN-APRIL.
newsitem.headline: GREEK MOTOR ACCIDENTS UP 9.8PCT Y/Y IN JAN-APRIL.

text.p: Greek car and motorcycle accidents rose 9.8 percent year-on-year to 6,944 in January-April from 6,322 in the same period in 1996, the National Statistics Service (NSS) said in a statement.
Over the first four months of 1997, 589 individuals died, 1,027 suffered heavy injuries and 8,841 sustained minor injuries, it said.
Over the respective period of 1996, a total of 6,322 accidents resulted in 571 deaths, 840 heavy and 7,837 minor injuries, it said. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
